mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park with overcast skies, a third quarter moon, an overnight low of 56 degrees, and rain in the forecast.

The city is preparing for pavement repairs on November 9 and 10, impacting Nine Mound Road and several other streets, so please watch for no parking signs. Additionally, the city has updated the permit process for erosion control and stormwater management for construction projects.

There is plenty to do, with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow or take part in Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were caught riding prohibited eMotos, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
